title: Mini receipt
description:
A shop wants a tiny receipt printer. Read three things, in this order:

1. the item name (one word),
2. how many were bought (a whole number),
3. the price of one (a decimal number).

Then print the receipt in exactly this layout:

```
Item: Coffee
Quantity: 3
Each: 2.5
Total: 7.5
```
hints: You need three variables of three different types: a `std::string`, an `int` and a `double`.
The total is `quantity * price`. You can print the result of that calculation directly without storing it first.
stretch: Add a line "Tax: ..." that is 8% of the total. (The check will then fail, because the output changes. That is fine: you are exploring.)
